SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.717542, -75.750458 (Approximated from ZIP)
Reported Spill Volume: 14 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** I WAS FILLING MY CAR WITH GAS AND WENT INTO THE STORE FOR SOME COFFEE. SOMEONE CAME IN YELLING "IS THAT YOUR CAR - GAS IS GOING EVERYWHERE"!? I WENT OUT TO FIND THAT THE PUMP NEVER AUTOMATICALLY SHUT OFF AND HAD BEEN OVERFLOWING FOR A LONG TIME. I ONLY NEEDED ABOUT HALF A TANK WHICH SHOULD HAVE BEEN ABOUT 6 OR 7 GALLONS. I BELIEVE IT TAKES ABOUT 11 -12 GALLONS WHEN TOTALLY EMPTY. IT HAD ALREADY PUMPED OUT 18 + GALLONS. SO I AM ASSUMING ABOUT 12 GALLONS WAS ON THE GROUND AND RUNNING INTO THE STREET AND RAIN WATER DISPOSAL SYSTEM. I TOLD THE WORKER TO CLOSE THE PUMP CAUSE IT WAS DANGEROUS. HE SAID WE DIDN'T KNOW ABOUT IT UNTIL NOW. HE ALSO REFUSED TO REFUND THE MONEY AND THAT WHEN THE MANAGER CAME HE WOULD REFUND THE MONEY. I WAS NEVER CALLED AND WHEN I CALLED THEY SAID IT WAS MY FAULT BECAUSE I SHOULD STAY WITH MY CAR. WHEN I LEFT THE PUMP WAS NOT CLOSED...OR MARKED IN ANY WAY. THEY DID NOT SEEM CONCERNED ABOUT THE CONSIDERABLE SPILL OR THAT THEY STOLE MY MONEY OR HOW MANY LAWS WERE BROKEN THAT THE GAS DID NOT SHUT OFF AND OVERFLOWED INTO THE STREET.

***WEB REPORT*** I WAS FILLING MY CAR WITH GAS AND WENT INTO THE STORE FOR SOME COFFEE. SOMEONE CAME IN YELLING "IS THAT YOUR CAR - GAS IS GOING EVERYWHERE"!? I WENT OUT TO FIND THAT THE PUMP NEVER AUTOMATICALLY SHUT OFF AND HAD BEEN OVERFLOWING FOR A LONG TIME. I ONLY NEEDED ABOUT HALF A TANK WHICH SHOULD HAVE BEEN ABOUT 6 OR 7 GALLONS. I BELIEVE IT TAKES ABOUT 11 -12 GALLONS WHEN TOTALLY EMPTY. IT HAD ALREADY PUMPED OUT 18 + GALLONS. SO I AM ASSUMING ABOUT 12 GALLONS WAS ON THE GROUND AND RUNNING INTO THE STREET AND RAIN WATER DISPOSAL SYSTEM. I TOLD THE WORKER TO CLOSE THE PUMP CAUSE IT WAS DANGEROUS. HE SAID WE DIDN'T KNOW ABOUT IT UNTIL NOW. HE ALSO REFUSED TO REFUND THE MONEY AND THAT WHEN THE MANAGER CAME HE WOULD REFUND THE MONEY. I WAS NEVER CALLED AND WHEN I CALLED THEY SAID IT WAS MY FAULT BECAUSE I SHOULD STAY WITH MY CAR. WHEN I LEFT THE PUMP WAS NOT CLOSED...OR MARKED IN ANY WAY. THEY DID NOT SEEM CONCERNED ABOUT THE CONSIDERABLE SPILL OR THAT THEY STOLE MY MONEY OR HOW MANY LAWS WERE BROKEN THAT THE GAS DID NOT SHUT OFF AND OVERFLOWED INTO THE STREET.
